limitations: Manufacturer STL covers the housing and four caps. Fastener heads, contact disks, rear pads, connectors, glass and label supports are external estimates from official photos and CAD recesses.
Rear PCB is an UNKNOWN placeholder. Internal fastener lengths, vents, components and electrical connection geometry are not established by the STL.
Connector locations are visual. Port A TX/RX labels disagree with the official factory program; the model does not enable cables.
Original photographs and their cut-out printed artwork are M5Stack material. CAD derivative and CAD source retain the bundled MIT license.
No hardware was used to calibrate appearance, LCD brightness, physical dimensions or form fit.
cameraNotes: Camera scale/center calibrated to original official silhouette and independent body dimensions; no geometry rescaling.
